description: MQ-series analog gas sensors (MQ-2, MQ-3, MQ-4, MQ-5, MQ-7, MQ-8, MQ-9, MQ-135...): sensor resistance, Rs/R0 ratio, clean-air calibration and ppm from the datasheet curve

calibrate.description: Sample for ~5 s in clean air and set R0 = Rs / clean_air_ratio (ratios in tips); returns R0 in kOhm.

ppm.description: Concentration from the datasheet curve ppm = a * (Rs/R0)^b (constants in tips).

r0.description: Current R0 in kOhm (save it to storage after calibrating).

ratio.description: Rs/R0: 1 at the calibration point, falls as gas increases.

set_divider.description: Voltage divider factor between AO and the pin, e.g. 1.5 for 10k over 20k (default 1 = no divider).

set_load.description: Load resistor RL on the module in kOhm (default 10).

set_r0.description: Restore a saved R0 in kOhm.

voltage.description: Module output voltage in V (corrected for the divider).

name: MQ

specs.load_resistor: RL usually 1k (newer) or 10k (older) on modules - check the SMD marked 102 or 103
specs.output: 0 - 5V analog (AO); use a divider for the 3.3V ADC
specs.preheat: 24-48 h burn-in when new, then ~1-3 min after each power-up

tips: Clean-air Rs/R0 for calibrate(): MQ-2 9.83, MQ-3 60, MQ-4 4.4, MQ-5 6.5, MQ-7 27.5, MQ-8 70, MQ-9 9.6, MQ-135 3.6.
Calibrate outdoors or in fresh air after warm-up, save r0() to storage, and restore it with set_r0() at boot.
Readings shift with temperature and humidity; treat ppm as an estimate, good for thresholds and trends.
MQ-7 and MQ-9 are specified with a cycling 5V/1.4V heater; on a constant 5V module their CO reading is only indicative.

pins.label: AO
pins.note: Analog out to an ADC pin through a divider (e.g. 10k/20k -> set_divider(1.5)); 5V on an ESP32 pin damages it

pins.label: DO
pins.note: Comparator output, threshold set by the trimmer (not used by this driver)
